messages:
maya: Nightly eval alert: ~5% drop on promptset 'docs-extraction' after int8 + packed-KV canary. Dashboard: https://redwoodintel/canary/3. Spinning up triage now. cc @sam @alex

sam: On it. Pushed the full eval logs and diffs to the gist -> https://gist.github.com/redwood/packedkv-regression

alex: Quick TL;DR? severity and a short reproducer?

sam: Reproducer is small: mixed-length documentation QA prompts. Fail mode = duplicated sentences + missing clauses. Baseline fp16 unaffected. Failure only on int8-packed-kv artifact.

jon: I grabbed runtime logs from canary-3. Noticed strange KV offset deltas in the packed path. snippet:
```
[2026-03-19T02:14:12Z] packkv: write_offset=4096 expected=4096
[2026-03-19T02:14:12Z] packkv: read_offset=4096
[2026-03-19T02:14:12Z] packkv: read_offset_delta=-8  <-- suspicious small negative delta
```

eva: Could be a tokenizer normalization mismatch leading to different token spans -> packed-KV index misalignment. We saw a similar symptom when newline normalization changed in an earlier rollout. Check tokenizer config flag `norm_whitespace`.

sam: Confirmed: the new model artifact's tokenizer has `norm_whitespace=false` while baseline had `true`. Token boundaries differ for many multi-line docs -> different token ids -> different expected KV table indices.

maya: Root cause hypothesis: model was packaged with a tokenizer variant (norm_whitespace mismatch) + packed-KV layout assumptions baked into int8 packing step. The int8/packed codepath amplifies tiny index misalignments, causing cached KV lookups to return shifted context -> duplication/hallucination.

alex: Good catch. What's the immediate mitigation surface?

maya: Immediate actions: rollback canary to the fp16 model and pause further int8-packedkv rollouts. Short-term: add a gating check in nightly eval that runs a `token_to_kv_consistency` probe across stratified prompt lengths. Medium-term: require tokenizer checksum match in model onboarding. Long-term: add automatic rollback + stronger CI gates for any model that changes tokenizer-normalizer semantics.

alex: I'll implement the canary pipeline gate + an automatic rollback job. Draft rollback command for ops run:
```
redwoodctl deploy rollback --canary canary-3 --to-model model-redwood-v2-fp16 --reason "packedkv-int8-regression"
```

sam: I'll add tokenizer checksum verification to the onboarding checklist and a unit test that compares tokenization of a representative set (including newlines, tabs, unicode) between baseline and candidate. I'll also add the stratified promptset to nightly eval matrix.

jon: I'll craft a small unit repro that intentionally exercises packed-KV offsets and add an assertion for read_offset_delta >= 0 in the runtime test suite. Will open PR shortly.

ops-bot: Deploy bot: rollback initiated for canary-3 by alex at 2026-03-19T02:48:05Z. Status: in-progress.

maya: Owners & timeline: alex = rollback + gating rule (now), sam = onboarding/tests (EOD), jon = runtime test + PR (EOD), eva = postmortem doc + notes (next-week). Rollback first, then merge tests/gates. Sound good?

alex: 👍

sam: I'll take the tests and checklist updates.

jon: Will open PR with repro and failing test by EOD.

eva: I'll draft the postmortem and include recommended gating thresholds and sample inputs.

maya: Thanks all — I'll create ticket RW-3456, link to the gist and this thread, and follow up with the postmortem template.

maya: Final note: add a CI check that compares tokenizer checksum and a quick smoke run of docs-extraction (10 samples) before any model promotion to canary.
